items.title: Two Italians killed in strike in Kuwait, as Iran denies responsibility
items.summary: The pair were technicians for German company Rheinmetall, according to Italy's foreign ministry.

confirmed_facts.text: Iran has denied responsibility for the attack, with Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi saying the incident looked "suspicious" and that Tehran would work with Kuwait and Italy to "determine the cause".

confirmed_facts.text: Kuwait's defence ministry said earlier that four people - the two Italians, a Kuwaiti national and Pakistani national - had been injured from falling shrapnel after a number of drones from Iran were detected and intercepted.

items.title: Spain’s Pablo Hernandez de Cos to succeed Lagarde as European Central Bank chief
items.summary:
Spain’s Pablo Hernandez de Cos will be the next head of the European Central Bank, taking over from Christine Lagarde, diplomats said on Thursday.
His nomination comes at a time of tension on European bond markets and before a series of high-stakes elections in Europe next year, including in France.
Hernandez de Cos, 55, has been head of the Swiss-based Bank for International Settlements (BIS) since last year, and previously led the Bank of Spain from 2018 to 2024.

items.title: Introducing the llama.cpp benchmark dashboard for AMD Ryzen and Radeon

confirmed_facts.text: Introducing the llama.cpp benchmark dashboard for AMD Ryzen and Radeon The llama.cpp × AMD Benchmark dashboard is available on Hugging Face.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Introducing the llama.cpp benchmark dashboard for AMD Ryzen and Radeon The llama.cpp × AMD Benchmark dashboard is available on Hugging Face.

confirmed_facts.text: It lets you track prompt processing and text generation performance across llama.cpp builds, models, and quantizations, so you can explore how local inference performs on AMD Ryzen and Radeon hardware.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: It lets you track prompt processing and text generation performance across llama.cpp builds, models, and quantizations, so you can explore how local inference performs on AMD Ryzen and Radeon hardware.

confirmed_facts.text: Local inference performance changes as models, kernels, and builds evolve.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Local inference performance changes as models, kernels, and builds evolve.

confirmed_facts.text: We want those changes to be easy to inspect for any AMD developer: pick a hardware, a model and a build, compare quantizations, and follow performance over time.
